company.title: Company Settings
company.subtitle: Manage your organization's core details, localization, and preferences.

branding.title: Branding
branding.logoHint: Square image, at least 256×256. Shown in the sidebar and on customer-facing documents.
branding.autosaveNote: Images are saved as soon as you upload them — the buttons at the bottom of this page do not apply to them.
branding.ownerOnly: Only Business Owners can change workspace branding.

localization.title: Localization
localization.subtitle: Regional formats for the organization.
localization.currencyHint: Used for prices, quotations and reports. Amounts already recorded are not converted — only the symbol they are shown with changes.
localization.timezoneHint: Decides which day an appointment or figure belongs to. The dashboard and the calendar both use it, so they always agree.
localization.dateFormatHint: Controls the order of day, month and year wherever dates are shown across the workspace.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies to everyone who has not chosen their own language, and to invitation emails — whose recipients have no account yet, so there is no personal preference to read.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.subtitle: Manage quotation workflow settings.
quotations.requireApprovalHint: If enabled, Staff quotations must be approved by a Business Owner before sending.

clientManagement.title: Client Management Settings
clientManagement.label: Label

clientManagement.deleteFieldGeneric: Are you sure you want to delete this field? This cannot be undone.
clientManagement.deleteFieldPrimaryEmail: This field is currently used as this workspace's primary email. Deleting it will stop quotation emails from being sent to clients until you set a new Primary Email field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldPrimaryName: This field is currently used as the client's display name. Deleting it will make new client records show as "Client" until you set a new Primary Name field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldStatus: This field is currently used for the client status report. Deleting it will remove the status breakdown from Reports until you set a new Status field.
clientManagement.deleteFieldAssignee: This field is currently used to track which staff member a client is assigned to. Deleting it will affect staff dashboard scoping until you set a new Assigned To field.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Every number in the pricing model. A change applies to the next calculation; offers already created keep their prices.
pricing.loadFailed: The pricing configuration could not be loaded.

hints.bands: The base fee is the price for the first employee of the band, and each extra employee adds the fee per employee. Active bands may not overlap. Above the last band, the price is "on request".
hints.risk: A surcharge on the base fee for each risk level. A company's risk level comes from its business type.
hints.frequencies: A percentage of the base fee, or a fixed monthly amount, such as for ad hoc visits.
hints.zones: A surcharge on the base fee for the cities of each zone. A city can be in more than one zone; the salesperson chooses.
hints.cap: The highest discount a salesperson may give without approval.
hints.services: What the offer describes. A service has no price of its own: the pricing model sets the price. A service in a package can be deactivated but not deleted.
hints.packages: A package is a named set of services the salesperson chooses on the pricing screen. It describes the offer and does not change the price. One active package is the default.
hints.offer: How offers are numbered and how long they stay valid, the company details printed on every offer, and its standard texts.
hints.calculator: Try the current configuration. Nothing is saved and no offer is created.
